title: ConsoleMessage
description: One frame of the minato console WebSocket protocol. Direction is determined by `type`: clients send rcon/ping, servers send log/rcon-response/status/error. See docs/agent-developers/console-protocol.md.

id.description: Optional correlation id echoed between request and response

data.description: Payload: rcon command, ping message, rcon response, status state, or error message
